32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: 5 of 9 cells render blank in the screenshot (screenshot captured before staggered initialization completes), making the gallery look broken despite a clean grid layout and intentional Tol Bright palette on the cells that do render.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Bar and area morphs maintain zero baselines and d3.pack() handles circle area-encoding correctly, but all scale domains are hardcoded magic numbers rather than data-driven, and this is an animation gallery rather than a quantitative visualization so no meaningful lie factor or axis deception is possible.
flags: Stale Closure (mutable currentBaseline in initLineArea tween)
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: Purely automated animation gallery with no user interaction handlers renders most stress-test criteria N/A; minor risks are absent .interrupt() calls before chained transitions and shared mutable closure state in initLineArea's attrTween.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell gallery with clear per-cell labels and contained independent animations reads as an organized reference rather than an overloaded dashboard; all 9 loops running simultaneously creates background visual noise, but cells are self-contained enough that viewers can focus on one at a time — the screenshot shows 6 cells appearing empty due to staggered initialization timing, which is a capture artifact, not a design flaw.
